reports.title: HESS MIDSTREAM LP REPORTS ESTIMATED RESULTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER OF 2026

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: Hess Midstream is reiterating its updated full year 2026 guidance from the October 6, 2026 news release, as follows:

Net income | 650 - 675
Adjusted EBITDA | 1,225 - 1,250
Capital expenditures | 105
Adjusted free cash flow | 910 - 935

Gas gathering - MMcf of natural gas per day | 435 - 445
Crude oil gathering - MBbl of crude oil per day | 110 - 120
Gas processing - MMcf of natural gas per day | 425 - 435
Crude terminals - MBbl of crude oil per day | 120 - 130
Water gathering - MBbl of water per day | 120 - 130

Hess Midstream expects to continue to target annual distribution per Class A share growth of 5% per share on an annualized basis in the fourth quarter of 2026. Hess Midstream expects to maintain its quarterly distributions in 2027 consistent with the expected fourth quarter 2026 distribution amount and intends to maintain at least that distribution level going forward fully funded by Adjusted Free Cash Flow.
